header: Conﬁguring a domain to use Amazon Cognito authentication
content:
After you complete the prerequisites, you can conﬁgure an OpenSearch Service domain to use
Amazon Cognito for Dashboards.
Note
Amazon Cognito is not available in all AWS Regions. For a list of supported Regions;, see
Service endpoints for Amazon Cognito. You don't need to use the same Region for Amazon
Cognito that you use for OpenSearch Service.
